claim: Live physical capital = machines + maintaining_humans + tools. The maintainer is thermodynamically inseparable from the capital.
known_evidence: Every industrial system ever measured shows monotonic degradation without maintenance. No counterexample exists.
null_hypothesis: Capital can sustain output indefinitely without human maintainers.
required_measurement: Equipment MTBF and output over time with vs. without maintenance crew. Measured in joules of useful work.

claim: CEO removal has no immediate physical effect on capital. Mechanic removal causes measurable capital decay within days-weeks.
known_evidence: Anecdotal + historical (strikes, lockouts) consistently show production halts when workers leave, continues when execs leave. No controlled trial exists.
null_hypothesis: CEO removal causes faster physical decay than mechanic removal.
required_measurement: Controlled comparison: remove CEO vs. remove maintenance crew from identical facilities. Measure uptime, failure rate, output.

claim: CEO 'scope of decisions' is a self-assigned property, not a physically measured one. The assignment is circular: those who hold power define the metric that justifies holding power.
known_evidence: No such metric has been published. Raelin (2020) confirms democratic leadership occurs only with permission of hierarchy.
null_hypothesis: An external, physics-based metric exists that independently justifies CEO authority over mechanic authority.
required_measurement: Identify any metric for CEO authority that does not reference legal title, board appointment, or historical precedent.

claim: Credentialing systems have never been tested apple-to-apple against uncertified-but-experienced practitioners on OUTCOME metrics (repair durability, child development, safety incidents).
known_evidence: 2013 child-worker study used supervisor ratings only. 2024 India study measured wages only. 2024 auto-repair study found 90% post-repair total-loss rate but did not stratify by certification status.
note: The experiment the church refuses to run.
null_hypothesis: A controlled trial exists comparing certified vs. uncertified workers on physical/outcome metrics.
required_measurement: Literature search for RCTs or quasi-experiments with outcome measures, not supervisor ratings or wage proxies.

claim: Emotions are evolutionarily conserved functional data streams, not noise. Excluding them from models of intelligence is an arbitrary methodological choice, not a scientific requirement. Affective processing is present across vertebrates including fish, and functions as a sensor suite tuned by natural selection.
known_evidence: Damasio (1994): ventromedial prefrontal lesion patients lose decision capacity despite intact logic (somatic marker hypothesis). Panksepp (1998+): seven core affective circuits (SEEKING, RAGE, FEAR, LUST, CARE, PANIC/GRIEF, PLAY) mapped subcortically across all mammals — predates cortex, therefore predates 'higher' cognition. LeDoux (1996+): amygdala processes threat faster than cortex can consciously register — body acts before 'you' decide. Not bias; a faster sensor path with survival value. Barrett (2017): constructed emotion theory — emotions are predictive models built from interoception, not hardwired reflexes. Different framework than Panksepp but same conclusion: functional computation. Sneddon et al. (2003): first identification of nociceptors in teleost fish (rainbow trout). A-delta and C fibers with properties identical to mammalian nociceptors. Sneddon (2003b): morphine blocks pain-related behavioral changes in trout (guarding, feeding cessation) — analgesic response indicates affective component, not mere reflex. Zebrafish acid/analgesic tank-choice experiments: fish injected with acid abandon preferred enriched tank for barren tank with painkillers — trade-off behavior requiring valenced experience. Avoidance learning in trout: fish learn to flee light cue 10s before net entry within 5 days — memory-based fear response. Braithwaite (2010), Broom, AVMA: consensus that fish should be accorded same pain considerations as terrestrial vertebrates. Rose (2002) neocortex-requirement argument would exclude all birds and most mammals from pain. Sneddon: convergent evolution of different neural architectures serving equivalent functions. Anencephalic human children express emotions despite missing cortex — brainstem circuits sufficient for affect. Affective systems conserved across vertebrates (>500 Myr). Invertebrate nociception: cephalopods show sustained motivational state changes after tissue damage (Crook et al. 2013). Hermit crabs make valenced trade-offs between shell quality and noxious stimulus avoidance (Elwood). Excluding emotion from observation violates observer effect: the observer IS emotional. Denying this is not objectivity — it is unconscious bias operating without correction.
note: Evidence spans mammals (Damasio, Panksepp, LeDoux, Barrett), fish (Sneddon, Braithwaite), invertebrates (Crook, Elwood). The neocortex-requirement objection (Rose 2002) is refuted by convergent evolution and anencephalic expression data.
null_hypothesis: Organisms that suppress emotional processing outperform those that integrate it, across survival and decision quality.
required_measurement: Compare decision quality in emotion-intact vs. emotion-impaired subjects. Compare survival rates in species with vs. without affective systems. Test across phyla, not just mammals.

claim: Current AI lacks stake (cost of failure), embodied sensing, and meta-learning (updating the update rule). Therefore it pattern-matches but does not learn-to-learn.
known_evidence: Meta-learning research (MAML, etc.) optimizes initialization but does not modify the optimizer itself at inference. No deployed system demonstrates autonomous meta-learning.
note: MAML is meta-training, not meta-learning at inference.
null_hypothesis: An AI system exists that updates its own learning algorithm in response to novel failure, without human retraining.
required_measurement: Present AI with a problem class absent from training data. Observe whether it modifies its own optimization procedure (not just its weights) in response to failure.

claim: Mycorrhizal networks and mitochondria meet the criteria for 'body-as-sensor-array': boundary, sensors, integration, history, and stake. Intelligence does not require neurons.
known_evidence: Simard et al. (1997, Nature): first field demonstration of net carbon transfer between tree species via ectomycorrhizal networks in mixed temperate rainforest. Simard (2018): network topology is scale-free with small-world properties — correlated with local/global efficiencies found in neural networks. Kin recognition: Douglas-fir preferentially transfers more carbon to genetically related seedlings via shared mycorrhizal networks (Asay et al. 2020; Gorzelak 2017). Defense signaling: injured Douglas-fir sends chemical warning signals through CMN to ponderosa pine, which then produces defense enzymes (Song et al. 2015). Resource allocation is context-dependent: direction of carbon flow shifts seasonally, toward parts of network in greatest need. Electrochemical impulses similar to nerve signals travel through mycorrhizal hyphae (emerging research). CONTESTED: Karst et al. (2023, Nature Ecol Evol) critiques positive citation bias in CMN literature. Simard et al. (2025, Frontiers) responds with detailed rebuttal. The existence of CMNs and preferential transfer is not disputed; the mechanism and magnitude of 'mother tree' effects is debated. Mitochondria are autonomous organelles with own genome, descended from endosymbiotic bacteria (~2 Byr ago). Fission/fusion dynamics: not passive — mitochondria actively sense metabolic state (ATP/ADP ratio, calcium, ROS, temperature) and respond by fusing (complementation of damaged units) or dividing (segregation of dysfunctional organelles). Twig et al. (2008, EMBO): fission produces uneven daughters — one with higher membrane potential (proceeds to fusion), one with lower potential (isolated for autophagy). This is selective quality control: sense, assess, segregate, remove. Mitochondria relocate within cells to sites of high energy demand — especially in neurons, where they travel long distances along axons, pausing at synapses. Youle & van der Bliek (2012, Science): fusion/fission regulated by proteolytic processing, ubiquitylation, sumoylation, phosphorylation — multiple signal integration pathways. Kowald & Kirkwood (2011, PNAS): evolutionary model shows fusion-fission cycle evolved as quality control mechanism; intact proton gradient required for fusion means only functional mitochondria merge. Both systems meet all criteria: Boundary: hyphal wall / double membrane. Sensors: chemical, pH, electrical, mechanical, thermal / ATP-ADP, calcium, ROS, membrane potential. Integration: network-wide resource allocation / retrograde signaling to nucleus, metabolic switching. History: growth pattern reflects past encounters / fission-fusion history affects current function. Stake: wrong allocation = reduced nutrient exchange / failure = cell death.
note: Mycorrhizal CMN debate (Karst vs. Simard) is about magnitude, not existence. Mitochondrial autonomy is undisputed. Both meet body-as-sensor-array criteria without neurons.
null_hypothesis: Mycorrhizal networks allocate resources randomly, without integrating chemical/electrical/mechanical signals. Mitochondria are passive organelles without adaptive behavior.
required_measurement: Isotope tracing of resource allocation in mycorrhizal networks under varied partner-quality conditions. Time-lapse imaging of mitochondrial fission/fusion dynamics under stress gradients.

claim: Non-Western and Indigenous empirical knowledge systems (TEK) represent independent, long-duration, outcome-tested scientific practice. Dismissing them as 'non-scientific' is a definitional exclusion by the credentialing church, not a failure of method.
known_evidence: Samoan traditional remedy (Psychotria insularum / matalafi): Molimau-Samasoni (2013+) confirmed anti-inflammatory properties comparable to ibuprofen — Western science validated what healers knew for generations. Dene caribou subcategories: Indigenous language distinctions map ecological variations not yet named in Western taxonomy. The vocabulary IS the empirical record. Hailzaqv (Heiltsuk) bear ecology: place-based knowledge guided hair-snare placement for DNA capture-recapture, producing novel population data that challenged provincial government policy (Housty et al. 2014). Australian Aboriginal fire management: >60,000 years of landscape-scale controlled burns — empirically superior to Western fire suppression, now being adopted by agencies. TEK validation process: individual observation, sharing with other users and elders, time-testing over generations. This IS peer review + longitudinal replication, just not institutionalized. TEK observers are resource users (hunters, fishers, gatherers) whose survival depends on observation accuracy — embodied stake that academic observers lack. Houde (2007): six facets of TEK — factual observations, management systems, past/current uses, ethics/values, culture/identity, cosmology. Only the first is recognized by Western science; the other five are dismissed as 'non-scientific.' Western science frames itself as 'testable knowledge' and dismisses TEK as 'experiential' — but TEK has been tested by survival over millennia, which is a harder test than peer review. Jessen et al. (2022, Frontiers in Ecology): 87% of studies using IK employed 'extractive model' — taking knowledge without benefiting source communities. The church extracts from uncertified masters even while denying their legitimacy. IPBES (2024): braiding TEK with Western science now recognized as essential for transformative change in biodiversity conservation.
note: TEK is independently derived empirical science with multi-generational replication. Its exclusion from 'science' is definitional, not evidential. Landscape-encoded knowledge transmission (spatial markers, star-trail navigation, fire calendars) constitutes functional engineering misclassified as ceremonial or cultural.
null_hypothesis: TEK-derived practices produce worse ecological, agricultural, or health outcomes than credentialed Western alternatives when applied to the same landscapes over comparable timescales.
required_measurement: Controlled comparison of TEK-managed vs. Western-managed ecosystems on biodiversity, soil health, fire resilience, species conservation, and food system sustainability. Multi-generational timescale required (decades minimum).

claim: Money fails as a scientific unit of measurement before it fails as a store of value. Its definition changes with regulation, accounting standards (GAAP, IFRS), interest rate policy, reporting incentives, and institutional context. No audit has ever validated that any monetary unit measures a stable physical quantity. Physical capital is a flow requiring continuous energy input; money pretends to be a stock. The exchange rate between them is a political variable, not a physical constant. Financial accounting and thermodynamic accounting are incommensurable systems applied to the same substrate.
known_evidence: Physical measurement units (meter, kilogram, joule, second) are defined by physical constants: speed of light, Planck's constant, Boltzmann's constant. They do not change when legislation changes. They mean the same thing to every participant. Money has none of these properties. GAAP has been revised hundreds of times since 1936. IFRS differs from GAAP on revenue recognition, lease accounting, inventory valuation, R&D capitalization. The same physical asset valued under different standards produces different dollar amounts. This means the 'unit' itself is context-dependent — a ruler whose length changes depending on who is measuring. Mark-to-market vs. mark-to-model vs. historical cost: three different accounting methods produce three different dollar values for the same physical object at the same moment. No physical measurement system tolerates this. Goodwill, intangible assets, deferred tax assets: accounting categories with no physical referent whatsoever, yet counted as 'value' on corporate balance sheets. No metrological audit has ever been performed on any monetary unit. No standards body has certified that '$1' measures a stable quantity of anything. The unit has never been calibrated. Landauer's principle: erasing one bit costs minimum kT ln 2 joules. Information is physical. Money is information. But money does not obey conservation laws — central banks create it by fiat, destroying any fixed relationship to physical quantity. USD purchasing power: ~96% loss since 1913 (BLS CPI data). The 'store' leaks continuously, but the leak rate is set by political decisions (interest rates, money supply), not by thermodynamic law. Physical capital depreciates according to entropy: machines rust, soil depletes, skills atrophy. Maintenance is the energy flow that counteracts this. Money cannot perform maintenance. It can only command others to perform it — and that command depends on social agreements that can collapse (hyperinflation, sanctions, bank runs, currency crises). Conservation laws apply to mass-energy, not to currency. delta M_earth = M_in - M_out is a closed equation. The financial ledger has no equivalent closure — money can be created and destroyed without any physical event occurring. Double-entry bookkeeping balances symbols, not atoms. Fractional reserve banking creates money as debt — each loan increases the money supply without increasing physical capital. The gap between monetary claims and physical backing widens monotonically until a correction event (crash, default, hyperinflation) forces reconciliation with physics. What '$1 of earnings' means differs by: industry, accounting method chosen, regulatory regime, and who is asking. The same physical transaction produces different monetary values depending on reporting incentives. This is not a measurement system. This is a narrative system with numbers attached. This disconnect is the mechanism by which the TITLE -> SURPLUS -> POWER -> ENFORCE loop operates: surplus is captured in money, which is a claim on future physical value that may not exist. The loop runs on promissory notes, not on joules.
note: The 96% USD purchasing power loss since 1913 rejects store-of-value. The hundreds of GAAP/IFRS revisions reject unit-of-measurement stability. No metrological calibration of any monetary unit has ever been performed. Money is a narrative system with numbers, not a measurement system with units.
null_hypothesis: A unit of currency corresponds to a fixed, conserved quantity of physical value (energy, exergy, negative entropy, or useful work capacity) that persists without energy input AND the unit's definition is stable across regulatory changes, accounting standard revisions, and institutional contexts.
required_measurement: Track the physical-value equivalent of $1 (in joules of useful work, kg of maintained capital, or hectares of fertile soil) over 50 years. If money is a valid measurement unit, the ratio should be constant. Simultaneously track: (a) changes in GAAP/IFRS definitions that alter what '$1 of revenue' means, (b) regulatory changes that alter what '$1 of capital' means, (c) incentive-driven reporting variations across industries, (d) what '$1' purchases in maintenance labor, energy, and materials.

claim: Information is physical (Landauer, Shannon-Boltzmann equivalence). Coordination, routing, and decision-making are therefore thermodynamic work, not abstract 'management.' The audit's target is not coordination itself — which is physically necessary — but coordinators whose signal path is so degraded (high transduction steps, high latency, low fidelity) that their decisions are effectively random while the system pretends they are optimal.
known_evidence: Landauer (1961): information erasure has minimum energy cost. Information processing is physical work. Therefore coordination is physical work, not merely 'social' or 'managerial.' Shannon (1948): entropy of information source equals thermodynamic entropy when measured in natural units. Signal-to-noise ratio degrades with each transduction step — this is fundamental, not fixable by better reporting software. Control theory (Nyquist, Bode): feedback loop stability requires latency below a critical threshold relative to system dynamics. A controller with latency longer than the system's characteristic timescale cannot stabilize it. CEO quarterly review cycle (90 days) vs. equipment failure timescale (hours-days) = guaranteed instability for maintenance decisions. Owner-operator businesses consistently show lower failure rates than absentee-owned equivalents in small manufacturing and agriculture (SBA data, USDA farm survival statistics). The mechanism: decision-maker IS the sensor, feedback latency ~= 0. The audit does not claim coordination is unnecessary. It claims that coordination quality is a function of signal fidelity and feedback latency — both measurable physical quantities — not of title, credential, or organizational rank.
note: This claim reframes the entire audit: the target is not hierarchy per se, but signal degradation. A flat organization with poor sensing is worse than a hierarchy with direct sensor coupling. The variable that matters is transduction steps between physical event and decision-maker, not org chart shape.
null_hypothesis: Coordination decisions made through high-latency, multi-layer abstracted signal paths (e.g., CEO reading quarterly reports) produce equal or better physical outcomes than coordination decisions made through low-latency, direct-sensing signal paths (e.g., shop dispatcher reading vibration data).
required_measurement: Compare physical outcomes (equipment lifespan, failure rate, maintenance cost per unit output, energy efficiency) between systems where coordination decisions are made by: (a) direct-sensing coordinators (1-2 transduction steps), vs. (b) abstracted coordinators (5-10 transduction steps via reports, dashboards, analyst summaries).
